shortBio: an M.Sc. Physics student specializing in Quantum Technology at SRMIST. I use mathematical models and numerical methods to study how confinement and ultrafast light pulses affect quantum systems.
about: I’m pursuing an M.Sc. in Physics with a specialization in Quantum Technology at SRMIST. My research interests include electron dynamics in curved geometries, light–matter interaction, and the numerical methods used to model them. In a preprint with Vivek S Babu, I studied how toroidal confinement affects a hydrogenic electron’s energy spectrum and response to attosecond excitation.
